# -------- Stage 1: Build the app --------
FROM node:20-bookworm AS builder

WORKDIR /app

# Disable husky hooks in CI
ENV HUSKY=0
RUN printf '#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n' > /usr/local/bin/husky && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/husky

# Copy root manifests
COPY package.json package-lock.json ./

# Copy workspace manifests for dependency resolution
COPY shared/package.json shared/package.json
COPY shell/package.json shell/package.json
COPY mfe-fp/package.json mfe-fp/package.json
COPY mfe-kp/package.json mfe-kp/package.json
COPY mfe-mp/package.json mfe-mp/package.json
COPY mfe-verwaltungsakt/package.json mfe-verwaltungsakt/package.json
COPY mfe-vp/package.json mfe-vp/package.json
COPY mfe-ws/package.json mfe-ws/package.json
COPY mfe1/package.json mfe1/package.json
COPY mfe-ewm/package.json mfe-ewm/package.json


# Install dependencies for all workspaces
RUN npm ci

# Copy full source code
COPY . .

# Replace .env.production with .env.deployment for deployment build
COPY shell/.env.deployment shell/.env.production

# Build shared first (produces dist/index.js and dist/style.css)
RUN npm run build:shared

RUN ls -la shared/dist/

# Build all microfrontends in parallel
RUN npm run build:release --workspace=mfe-fp & \
    npm run build:injector --workspace=mfe-fp & \
    npm run build:release --workspace=mfe-kp & \
    npm run build:injector --workspace=mfe-kp & \
    npm run build:release --workspace=mfe-mp & \
    npm run build:injector --workspace=mfe-mp & \
    npm run build:release --workspace=mfe-verwaltungsakt & \
    npm run build:injector --workspace=mfe-verwaltungsakt & \
    npm run build:release --workspace=mfe-vp & \
    npm run build:injector --workspace=mfe-vp & \
    npm run build:release --workspace=mfe-ws & \
    npm run build:injector --workspace=mfe-ws & \
    npm run build:release --workspace=shell & \
    npm run build:injector --workspace=shell & \
    npm run build:release --workspace=mfe-ewm & \
    npm run build:injector --workspace=mfe-ewm & \
    wait

# Create non-root user
RUN useradd --uid 1001 --gid 0 --create-home appuser

USER 1001:0

# -------- Stage 2: Serve with Nginx --------
FROM nginxinc/nginx-unprivileged:1.29-alpine

# Copy built shell from builder stage
COPY --from=builder /app/shell/dist /usr/share/nginx/html

# Copy built microfrontends to their respective directories
COPY --from=builder /app/mfe-fp/dist /usr/share/nginx/html/mfe-fp
COPY --from=builder /app/mfe-kp/dist /usr/share/nginx/html/mfe-kp
COPY --from=builder /app/mfe-mp/dist /usr/share/nginx/html/mfe-mp
COPY --from=builder /app/mfe-verwaltungsakt/dist /usr/share/nginx/html/mfe-verwaltungsakt
COPY --from=builder /app/mfe-vp/dist /usr/share/nginx/html/mfe-vp
COPY --from=builder /app/mfe-ws/dist /usr/share/nginx/html/mfe-ws
COPY --from=builder /app/mfe-ewm/dist /usr/share/nginx/html/mfe-ewm


# Copy built microfrontends to their respective directories
COPY --from=builder /app/mfe-fp/dist-injector /usr/share/nginx/html/mfe-fp-injector
COPY --from=builder /app/mfe-kp/dist-injector /usr/share/nginx/html/mfe-kp-injector
COPY --from=builder /app/mfe-mp/dist-injector /usr/share/nginx/html/mfe-mp-injector
COPY --from=builder /app/mfe-verwaltungsakt/dist-injector /usr/share/nginx/html/mfe-verwaltungsakt-injector
COPY --from=builder /app/mfe-vp/dist-injector /usr/share/nginx/html/mfe-vp-injector
COPY --from=builder /app/mfe-ws/dist-injector /usr/share/nginx/html/mfe-ws-injector
COPY --from=builder /app/mfe-ewm/dist-injector /usr/share/nginx/html/mfe-ewm-injector


# Copy custom nginx configuration

COPY nginx-config/00-map-hash.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/00-map-hash.conf
COPY nginx-config/default.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
COPY nginx-config/cors-map.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/cors-map.conf
COPY nginx-config/cors-headers.conf /etc/nginx/snippets/cors-headers.conf


# Copy the environment injection script
COPY docker-entrypoint.sh /docker-entrypoint.sh

# Ensure the script is executable
USER root
RUN chmod +x /docker-entrypoint.sh
USER nginx

EXPOSE 8080

ENTRYPOINT ["/docker-entrypoint.sh"]=== package.json ===
{
	"name": "bmi-ki",
	"version": "1.0.0",
	"main": "index.js",
	"scripts": {
		"test": "npm run test:all",
		"check-versions": "syncpack list-mismatches",
		"fix-versions": "syncpack fix-mismatches",
		"update-deps": "npm update --workspaces && npm run fix-versions",
		"clean": "npm cache clean --force && npm cache verify && rimraf --glob node_modules \"**/node_modules\" \"**/dist\" package-lock.json",
		"clean:install": "npm run clean && npm install && npm run build --workspace=shared",
		"build:shared": "npm run build --workspace=shared",
		"build:mfe1": "npm run build --workspace=mfe1",
		"build:mfe-kp": "npm run build --workspace=mfe-kp",

		"build:mfe-mp": "npm run build --workspace=mfe-mp",
		"build:mfe-fp": "npm run build --workspace=mfe-fp",
		"build:mfe-verwaltungsakt": "npm run build --workspace=mfe-verwaltungsakt",
		"build:mfe-vp": "npm run build --workspace=mfe-vp",
		"build:mfe-ewm": "npm run build --workspace=mfe-ewm",

		"build-watch:shell": "npm run build:watch --workspace=shell",
		"build-watch:mfe-ws": "npm run build:watch --workspace=mfe-ws",
		"build-watch:mfe-verwaltungsakt": "npm run build:watch --workspace=mfe-verwaltungsakt",
		"build:all": "npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build:mfe1 && npm run build:mfe-fp && npm run build:mfe-kp && npm run build:mfe-mp && npm run build:mfe-verwaltungsakt && npm run build:mfe-vp && npm run build:mfe-ws && npm run build:shell",
		"build:all:injector": "npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build:injector --workspace=mfe1 && npm run build:injector --workspace=mfe-fp && npm run build:injector --workspace=mfe-kp && npm run build:injector --workspace=mfe-mp && npm run build:injector --workspace=mfe-verwaltungsakt && npm run build:injector --workspace=mfe-vp && npm run build:injector --workspace=mfe-ws && npm run build:injector --workspace=mfe-ewm && npm run build --workspace=shell",
		"build:monorepo": "npm run build:all",
		"build:mfes": "concurrently \"npm run build:mfe1\" \"npm run build:mfe-fp\" \"npm run build:mfe-kp\" \"npm run build:mfe-ws\" \"npm run build:mfe-verwaltungsakt\" \"npm run build:mfe-mp\" \"npm run build:mfe-vp\" \"npm run build:mfe-ewm\"",
		"dev:all": "npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build:mfes && concurrently -k -n Shell,MFE1-build,MFE1-preview,FP-build,FP-preview,KP-build,KP-preview,WS-build,WS-preview,VA-build,VA-preview,MP-build,MP-preview,VP-build,VP-preview,EWM-build,EWM-preview \"npm run dev --workspace=shell\" \"npm run build:watch --workspace=mfe1\" \"npm run preview --workspace=mfe1\" \"npm run build:watch --workspace=mfe-fp\" \"npm run preview --workspace=mfe-fp\" \"npm run build:watch --workspace=mfe-kp\" \"npm run preview --workspace=mfe-kp\" \"npm run build:watch --workspace=mfe-ws\" \"npm run preview --workspace=mfe-ws\" \"npm run build:watch --workspace=mfe-verwaltungsakt\" \"npm run preview --workspace=mfe-verwaltungsakt\" \"npm run build:watch --workspace=mfe-mp\" \"npm run preview --workspace=mfe-mp\" \"npm run build:watch --workspace=mfe-vp\" \"npm run preview --workspace=mfe-vp\" \"npm run build:watch --workspace=mfe-ewm\" \"npm run preview --workspace=mfe-ewm\"",
		"dev:all:injector": "npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build:all:injector && concurrently -k -n Shell,MFE1-build,MFE1-preview,FP-build,FP-preview,KP-build,KP-preview,WS-build,WS-preview,VA-build,VA-preview,MP-build,MP-preview,VP-build,VP-preview,EWM-build,EWM-preview \"npm run dev --workspace=shell\" \"npm run build:watch --workspace=mfe1\" \"npm run preview:injector --workspace=mfe1\" \"npm run build:watch --workspace=mfe-fp\" \"npm run preview:injector --workspace=mfe-fp\" \"npm run build:watch --workspace=mfe-kp\" \"npm run preview:injector --workspace=mfe-kp\" \"npm run build:watch --workspace=mfe-ws\" \"npm run preview:injector --workspace=mfe-ws\" \"npm run build:watch --workspace=mfe-verwaltungsakt\" \"npm run preview:injector --workspace=mfe-verwaltungsakt\" \"npm run build:watch --workspace=mfe-mp\" \"npm run preview:injector --workspace=mfe-mp\" \"npm run build:watch --workspace=mfe-vp\" \"npm run preview:injector --workspace=mfe-vp\" \"npm run build:watch --workspace=mfe-ewm\" \"npm run preview:injector --workspace=mfe-ewm\"",
		"docker:build": "docker build -t frontend-monorepo .",
		"docker:run": "docker run -p 8080:8080 frontend-monorepo",
		"preview:mfe1": "npm run preview --workspace=mfe1",
		"preview:shell": "npm run preview --workspace=shell",
		"preview:mfe-ws": "npm run preview --workspace=mfe-ws",
		"preview:mfe-kp": "npm run preview --workspace=mfe-kp",
		"preview:mfe-verwaltungsakt": "npm run preview --workspace=mfe-verwaltungsakt",
		"build-watch:mfe-mp": "npm run build:watch --workspace=mfe-mp",
		"preview:mfe-mp": "npm run preview --workspace=mfe-mp",
		"preview:build-watch:mfe-mp": "concurrently -k -n ShellBuild,MPBuild,ShellPreview,MPPreview,PrismStart \"npm run build:watch --workspace=shell\" \"npm run build:watch --workspace=mfe-mp\" \"npm run preview --workspace=shell\" \"npm run preview --workspace=mfe-mp\" \"npm run prism:start --workspace=shared -- mfe-mp-norm-matching\" \"npm run prism:start --workspace=shared -- mfe-mp-subsumtion\"",
		"test:all": "npm run test:shell && npm run test:mfe-mp && npm run test:mfe-kp && npm run test:mfe-fp && npm run test:mfe-verwaltungsakt && npm run test:mfe-vp && npm run test:mfe-ws && npm run test:mfe1",
		"test:shell": "npm run test:e2e --workspace=shell",
		"test:mfe-mp": "npm run test:e2e --workspace=mfe-mp",
		"test:mfe-kp": "npm run test:e2e --workspace=mfe-kp",
		"test:mfe-fp": "npm run test:e2e --workspace=mfe-fp",
		"test:mfe-verwaltungsakt": "npm run test:e2e --workspace=mfe-verwaltungsakt",
		"test:mfe-vp": "npm run test:e2e --workspace=mfe-vp",
		"test:mfe-ws": "npm run test:e2e --workspace=mfe-ws",
		"test:mfe1": "npm run test:e2e --workspace=mfe1",
		"prepare": "husky",
		"check-shared": "node ./tools/check-shared-imports.js",
		"lint-staged": "lint-staged",
		"lint": "npm run lint --workspaces --if-present",
		"format": "npm run format --workspaces --if-present",
		"format:check": "npm run format:check --workspaces --if-present"
